_readme: Copy this to <build-dir>/meta.json and fill it in. It drives geocode/emit/assemble.
srcSlug/srcCity/srcCenter describe the guide whose chrome you are cloning — keep it
pointed at the CURRENT GOLD reference (see _rollout/state.json gold5_ref).
tokenSwaps is the belt-and-braces sweep for place words the clone carries over;
anything you miss is caught again by staleTokens in the check config.
title: Place — Terroir Guide
desc: One sentence for the meta description: who it is for, the two or three facts that make this place itself, and the promise that every venue was checked.
_signature_note: GOLD5 §4 — the 2–4 sections this place is uniquely FOR go in sections_insert_after_walks, with their own lines/<id>.html. Kendwa used tide/dhow/reef/fullmoon. Never reuse another guide's; find this one's.
